FERRARI CERTIFIED PRE-OWNED | FERRARI APPROVED

This 2021 Ferrari Portofino has been enrolled in the Ferrari Approved Certified Pre-Owned Program — the manufacturer's most rigorous pre-owned standard — providing up to two years of additional Ferrari Power Approved Warranty coverage. Complimentary Ferrari Genuine Maintenance Service coverage through 01/31/2027.

Presented in the classic and striking color Bianco Avus over a Rosso Ferrari interior, includes Cavallino-stitched headrests and full special stitching in Nero throughout. One owner from new. Very low miles. Pristine condition throughout. Sold new by our dealership and maintained exclusively by our factory-trained technicians throughout its ownership.

Ferrari of Puerto Rico is the island's sole Official Ferrari Dealership — an authorized franchise of Ferrari S.p.A., staffed by Ferrari-certified technicians and dedicated to delivering the complete Ferrari ownership experience. Every vehicle we offer has been inspected, serviced, and prepared to the exacting standards of Maranello. When you acquire through us, you are acquiring with the full confidence of the factory behind you.

If you are in the market for a Ferrari Portofino, we invite you to contact our team today. Call +1 (787) 296-9996 or inquire online — our specialists are available to assist you personally.
